product_metadata.title: Brite Star 12-Feet Direct Plug in Lighted Pine Garland with 35 Count Multi-Colored Mini Lights
features: Decorate your house with the best Christmas light set, suitable for both indoor & outdoor use
Connect up to 14 sets of the same model
description: Garlands are always a great way to decorate your home with a traditional and warm holiday look. This 12' lighted pine garland gives you the luminescent splendor of 35 Multi colored incandescent mini lights. The garland has a 12" lead cord along with 4. 5" spacing between bulbs and 4" end cord. It can even connect up to 14 sets!

details.Special Feature: Available to plug at both ends!
